scripts.check: node --check src/worker.js && node --check public/app.js && node --check public/estado.js && npm test && npm run build
scripts.db:local: npx wrangler@4 d1 migrations apply PeloApp-dev --local --env dev
scripts.db:prod: npx wrangler@4 d1 migrations apply PeloApp-prod --remote
scripts.db:dev: npx wrangler@4 d1 migrations apply PeloApp-dev --remote --env dev
scripts.deploy: npm run check && npm run db:prod && npx wrangler@4 deploy
scripts.deploy:dev: npm run check && npm run db:dev && npx wrangler@4 deploy --env dev
